activation_state.finding: The defect is not VIT activation. It is incomplete mechanical enforcement of VIT lineage at downstream candidate-admission surfaces.

entrypoint_findings.pre_correction: Eligible packets can receive ALLOW_VIT_GENERAL_SERIALIZED_GATEWAY using authority/prerequisite/QA fields without proving a PacketIntegrationPayload, VirtualIntegrationGeneration or placement lineage.
entrypoint_findings.required_correction: Require valid PIP, VIT generation and placement identities before ALLOW.

entrypoint_findings.pre_correction: QueueCandidate can become READY using candidate head/base/QA/authority fields without any VIT provenance.
entrypoint_findings.required_correction: SIQ must fail closed without canonical PIP -> generation -> placement lineage.

entrypoint_findings.pre_correction: Pull-request assurance runs repository/parity tests but does not validate that a permanent PR has a repository-bound VIT lineage record before expensive assurance.
entrypoint_findings.required_correction: Add a required early VIT routing preflight to the existing workflow; do not create a third PR listener.

entrypoint_findings.pre_correction: Repository code cannot prevent an external actor from creating a Git ref before VIT admission.
entrypoint_findings.required_correction: Treat branch refs as non-authoritative and prevent them from becoming permanent integration candidates unless PR/SIQ VIT-lineage checks pass.

stale_main_case_reproduction.observed: Main advanced through unrelated RCCRI-WP7A while required assurance was running; the method-design bytes/hashes were preserved unchanged and no semantic conflict was observed.
Physical main advanced during exact-head assurance and the bounded PS0 payload was reconstructed onto a fresh current-main branch.

Exact-head QA found a real packet-local conformance defect: a research-only candidate registry changed the frozen C2P core registry count from 12 to 13. The successor moved the candidate research record outside the core registry namespace.
The RCCR gate evidence and authority classification were unchanged, but an unrelated Path-2 method-freeze main advance caused a fresh current-main gate candidate to be created.

historical_support.interpretation: The current defect reproduces the exact stale-main waste class VIT was designed to eliminate.

required_invariants: Every permanent eligible packet has canonical PIP identity before placement-sensitive candidate construction.
Every permanent integration candidate is bound to one PIP, VIT generation and VIT placement.
SIQ cannot READY-admit a candidate without VIT lineage.
Operator-required packets are represented in VIT and parked; they are not direct-main exceptions.
Unrelated physical-main movement with unchanged PIP/dependency/authority yields PLACEMENT_RECOMPUTE_ONLY and zero payload rebuilds.
Only an identity-bearing payload/dependency defect/change may produce PAYLOAD_REBUILD_REQUIRED.
Existing VIT/SIQ authority and one-head physical serialization remain unchanged.
registered_exception_policy: Only exact, finite bootstrap/recovery exceptions may bypass the PR-lineage preflight. No exception grants direct SIQ admission or new authority.
rollback: Forward-disable the correction only; preserve VIT active authority, SIQ serialization, all audit records, historical stale-main evidence and Git history.
